name: amiberry
description: Amiberry’s updater supports comparison with SHA-256 metadata supplied by a release. The check is conditional on an expected digest being available; independent publisher authentication and release-specific policy remain unresolved.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study release.
The cited source establishes a checksum control only; it does not establish publisher signatures or the complete released artifact channel.
